links.outcome: Time and treatment quality for clinician+AI versus clinician alone versus AI alone in randomized simulation
links.effect: Clinician-KOM collaboration reduced total diagnostic and planning time by 38.5% and improved treatment quality compared with each approach used independently.
links.quote: A randomized three-arm simulation study further revealed that collaboration between KOM and clinicians reduced total diagnostic and planning time by 38.5% and resulted in improved treatment quality compared to each approach used independently.

screen.reason: The study evaluates a multi-agent AI system (KOM) in benchmark experiments and a randomized three-arm simulation study comparing clinician alone, AI alone, and clinician-AI collaboration (human-in-the-loop workflow).
